title: NOVA Hourglass Hypertrophy System
author: Phylisia
desc:
The NOVA Hourglass Hypertrophy System was created with one major principle at its core: intentional progression. These workouts are designed to evolve week after week through progressive overload, meaning the goal is to gradually increase reps, resistance, control, strength, and tension over time in a safe and sustainable way. Progressive overload is not ego lifting, throwing on crazy weight, or ruining form. The goal is progressive tension over time. That is how we grow glutes consistently, build strength safely, improve longevity, and transform intentionally.

As I transition into my 40 year old era, my relationship with fitness has completely changed. This is no longer about punishing my body or chasing perfection. This is about protecting my future, improving longevity, preserving mobility, supporting emotional regulation, reducing stress, and becoming stronger physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually. Truthfully, emotional control has always been one of my greatest struggles unless I am consistently working out. The gym has often been the one place where my mind, body, and spirit finally feel aligned. Even my old injuries from a past car accident tend to bother me most when I am overweight, inactive, lacking muscle, and disconnected from my routines and mind-body-spirit connection.

At the same time, yes, I still want the booty. I want glute growth, the hourglass shape, and to feel feminine, athletic, confident, and strong. This program heavily prioritizes glute hypertrophy, posture, shoulder shaping, upper body balance, and core stability to help create a strong feminine hourglass physique while still maintaining overall functionality and strength.

This system was created through a combination of evidence based hypertrophy research, my university studies, personal fitness experiences, and artificial intelligence assisted optimization. I am highly skilled in research methods and AI advancement, and I intentionally combined science, lived experience, personal trainer knowledge, Beachbody programs, Chloe Ting workouts, strength training systems, and years of experimentation to create a program that feels realistic, affordable, accessible, and sustainable for everyday women.

I built my home gym piece by piece over time through Amazon, discount fitness warehouses, and secondhand platforms like Facebook Marketplace. One of my favorite purchases was a nearly brand new shaker/vibration machine originally worth almost $2800 that I purchased for only $150. At the same time, I also keep an affordable membership at Planet Fitness because sometimes it feels good to leave the house and train in a different environment. This program works both in a home gym and commercial gym setting.

Most importantly, this program is for every woman trying to rebuild herself, heal, grow, and become stronger after adversity.                                           

We are not shrinking ourselves anymore.
We are building ourselves intentionally.

Rear foot on bench 

Long stride
Forward lean
Right and left side 4 times each

Round upper back slightly
Push hips into pad
Squeeze glutes hard

One of your BIGGEST glute growth tools!!!
Slow controlled reps. Start low until you can do 15
Glute focused check position of pads
Do as many as you can and build up
2 sets following the steps front/side/reverse/side. Repeat once.
Front then reverse back and forth do a whole circle of your body starting with: front plank, side plank, reverse plank, side plank, repeate once: front plank, side plank, reverse plank, side plank,
